Name: Floral Tea
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
My first mod that adds a new big craftable, the Floral Tea Brewer!

How to Unlock [Spoilers]
* Obtain its crafting recipe upon reaching farming level 7.
* Costs 40 wood, 2 oak resin, and 1 iron bar to craft.

Floral Tea [Spoilers]
* Can be made by placing a flower and tea leaves in the tea brewer.
* Brewing floral tea takes 6 hours.
* The cost of the tea is "100 + 1.5B", wherein "B" is the base price of the provided flower.
* It is currently a universally liked item.

Huge thanks to LilacSweetie and their mod Flower Syrup Maker, which I used as a template for this mod!

Compatibility:
Should be compatible with most custom flower mods.
Compatible with Automate via PFMAutomate.

Future Plans:
* Add the normal buffs associated with green tea when drinking floral tea, alongside a +0.5 boost to luck.
* Give floral tea the same likes and dislikes as green tea.
* Add custom gift dialog for when Caroline is given floral tea.
